_comment: Every file listed here has been verified (by a human/agent, not automatically re-checked on every commit) as either shadcn/ui's real official registry source pulled via scripts/pull-shadcn-component.mjs, or rebased onto it with documented deltas in the file's own header comment. scripts/check-shadcn-only-primitives.mjs enforces that every components/ui/*.tsx file appears here — this manifest is the trust boundary, the same model the existing NAMED_ALLOWLIST pattern (scripts/check-guardrail-exemptions.mjs) already uses for other guardrails. Add a new entry only after actually pulling the real source (scripts/pull-shadcn-component.mjs <name>) and diffing it, never by assumption.
